entries.title: Proverbs 21:1
segments: ¶The king's heart in the hand of Jehovah is [as] brooks of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:2
segments: ¶Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; but Jehovah weigheth the hearts.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:3
segments: ¶To exercise justice and judgment is more acceptable to Jehovah than sacrifice.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:4
segments: ¶Lofty eyes, and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:5
segments: ¶The thoughts of the diligent [tend] only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty, only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:6
segments: ¶The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting breath of them that seek death.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:7
segments: ¶The devastation of the wicked sweepeth them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:8
segments: ¶Very crooked is the way of a guilty man; but as for the pure, his work is upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:9
segments: ¶It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a contentious woman, and a house in common.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:10
segments: ¶The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:11
segments: ¶When the scorner is punished, the simple becometh wise; and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:12
segments: ¶One that is righteous wisely considereth the house of the wicked: he overthroweth the wicked to [their] ruin.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:13
segments: ¶Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also himself shall cry, and shall not be heard.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:14
segments: ¶A gift in secret pacifieth anger; and a present in the bosom, vehement fury.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:15
segments: ¶It is joy to a righteous [man] to do what is right; but it is ruin for the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:16
segments: ¶The man that wandereth out of the way of wisdom shall abide in the congregation of the dead.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:17
segments: ¶He that loveth mirth shall be a poor man; he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:18
segments: ¶The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and a treacherous [man] in the stead of the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:19
segments: ¶It is better to dwell in a desert land. than with a contentious and irritable woman.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:20
segments: ¶There is costly store and oil in the dwelling of a wise [man]; but a foolish man swalloweth it up.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:21
segments: ¶He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:22
segments: ¶A wise [man] scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:23
segments: ¶Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:24
segments: ¶Proud, arrogant, scorner is his name who dealeth in proud wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:25
segments: ¶The desire of the sluggard killeth him; for his hands refuse to work:

entries.title: Proverbs 21:26
segments: He coveteth greedily all the day long; but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:27
segments: ¶The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more when they bring it with a wicked purpose!

entries.title: Proverbs 21:28
segments: ¶A lying witness shall perish; and a man that heareth shall speak constantly.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:29
segments: ¶A wicked man hardeneth his face; but as for the upright, he establisheth his way.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:30
segments: ¶There is no wisdom, nor understanding, nor counsel against Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 21:31
segments: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but safety is of Jehovah.
